description: Gets a league's scoreboard by league code: today's games and scores, the previous game day's finals and the games of the next three game days. Pass a date for another day, or a team id for that team's recent finals.

code.description: The league code, in any case.

date.description: The day the board shows in place of today; null is today in the league's day zone.

team.description: A club of the league whose last finals Recent holds in place of the league's; null for the league's.

name: get_league_board

build.description: The running build's id, so an unattended screen can reload on deploy.

latestObservation.description: The newest observation among today's stored results (UTC), or null when today has none.

zone.description: The league's day zone, as an IANA id.

events.description: The event detail of each of Today's games, for the page's structured data.

endTime.description: When it ends, in UTC: the stored end, else the start plus the league's match length.

previousStartTime.description: The start it was first set for, in UTC, when it has since moved; null when it never has.

venue.description: Where it is played, where the league holds the ground; null otherwise.

country.description: The country, as the provider names it.

zone.description: The zone the stadium clock keeps (IANA): the venue's, else the league's day zone.

field.description: A series' sessions, for a league whose contests are fields (Formula 1™); null for a league of team games.

previous.description: The last session classified before today, with its whole classification; null when there is none.

endTime.description: When it is due to end; null when the provider gives no length.

lap.description: While a race or sprint is live, the lap the leader is on, when the provider counts it.

laps.description: While a race or sprint is live, the laps it is planned to run.

meetingSlug.description: The meeting's evergreen slug, such as monaco-grand-prix.

name.description: The stage as an event names it, such as Qualifying.

places.description: The classification, first place first, as far as the page shows it; empty until there is one.

abbreviation.description: The timing-screen code, such as LEC.

fastestLap.description: In a race or sprint, the session's fastest lap (1:22.167) on the car that set it; null on every other car.

part.description: In qualifying, the part its best lap was set in and its place decided: Q3, Q1, SQ2.

status.description: classified, dnf, dns, dsq or nc.

time.description: In a race or sprint, the winner's time or another car's interval to it (+12.594, +1 Lap); in practice or qualifying, the car's best lap (1:13.978).

stage.description: The stage's code, such as qualifying or race.

state.description: scheduled, live, final, cancelled or postponed.

trackUrl.description: The meeting's track outline, its mark on a card; null when that season's circuit isn't drawn.

today.description: Every session starting today, in start order, each with its whole classification.

endTime.description: When it is due to end; null when the provider gives no length.

lap.description: While a race or sprint is live, the lap the leader is on, when the provider counts it.

laps.description: While a race or sprint is live, the laps it is planned to run.

upcoming.description: The next sessions after today, by start, without classifications.

state.description: scheduled, live, final, cancelled or postponed.

trackUrl.description: The meeting's track outline, its mark on a card; null when that season's circuit isn't drawn.

ingesting.description: Whether ingestion is switched on; a league switched off still answers, with scores that no longer move.

sport.description: The sport's code (SOCCER), which decides a screen's words: a soccer board shows matches, not games.

nextGameDay.description: The first day after today with a game, or null when none is stored.

previousGameDay.description: The latest day before today holding a final, however far back; null when there is none.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

outcome.description: How the game went for this side, as Outcome judges it; null until Final.

segments.description: The line score in the scoreboard's segment order; a null value is a segment not played.

order.description: Cricket: the innings' place in the match, 1 for the side that batted first; null in every other sport.

overs.description: Cricket: the overs the innings lasted, in overs-and-balls notation (19.4 is nineteen overs and four balls); null in every other sport.

value.description: The points scored, or null when the segment was not played; never zero for that.

wickets.description: Cricket: the wickets down in the innings; null in every other sport.

stats.description: The scoreboard's stats the provider reported, by key.

total.description: The provider's total, or null when no result carries one.

declared.description: How a final ended as the provider declared it, for a sport whose totals can't say (cricket): who won and by what, a tie, or no result. Null in every other sport and before the end.

margin.description: What the win was by, when the provider said; null on every other verdict, and on a win it gave no margin for.

innings.description: The winners batted once and still made more than the other side's two innings: "by an innings and 12 runs".

revised.description: The target was revised for lost time, by the Duckworth–Lewis–Stern method.

unit.description: Runs when the side batting first won, wickets when the side batting last did.

winner.description: The side that won; set on Won only.

break.description: The provider's pause between segments, which overrides the segment's reading on a board.

clock.description: The provider's timer text; always null when Source is Inferred.

half.description: Which half of the inning, on a scoreboard that PlaysHalves.

segment.description: The segment in play, in the scoreboard's keys; null when nothing places the game.

venue.description: The venue's name, where one is stored.

recent.description: The last finals before today, newest first, however far back: the league's, or one team's when the board was read for a team (Team). At most RecentCap; a screen shows as many as fit.
